headline: North Carolina wins more matches than any ACC side
dek: North Carolina has won seventeen times and lost twice, and since finishing behind Notre Dame in the conference table it has beaten Duke and then Virginia. Notre Dame lost to Virginia in the same week.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Goals have not decided the table: Louisville has scored more than Notre Dame and more than Wake Forest, yet finishes below both in conference play.

wire.line: Virginia has conceded twelve goals all season, fewer than one a match.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bella Devey, a North Carolina midfielder, has scored eighteen goals from 64 shots.

findings.label: observed

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
